statement: The three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz conjecture. Resolves the three-dimensional Bochner–Riesz conjecture in its strict range: the Bochner–Riesz multipliers of order δ are bounded on $`L^p(\mathbb R^3)`$ for every $`1\le p\le\infty`$ whenever $`\delta\gt \max\{3|1/p-1/2|-1/2,0\}`$.
